default.title: Secure sessions and personalized dashboard workspaces
default.summary: ClawPilot now provides independently revocable browser sessions and audited root support mode while remembering each user's dashboard board and pipeline with complete, stable scoped summaries.
features: A Security settings view listing active browsers with current-session identification, last activity, and individual revocation
A one-command control to sign out every other browser without interrupting the current session
Root support mode for viewing the application as an active non-owner user for up to 30 minutes
A persistent support-mode banner showing both the root administrator and the effective user
Role-aware idle limits with a 24-hour absolute browser-session lifetime and explicit activity renewal
Automatic upgrade of existing signed browser cookies to durable sessions during rollout
Independent board and pipeline selectors on the dashboard with durable defaults for each signed-in user
A selected-pipeline summary covering opportunities, organizations, contacts, and total open value
A stable Skeleton loading shell that reserves the dashboard layout while scoped workspace data resolves
fixes: Stores only keyed token hashes in Postgres rather than reusable browser credentials
Revokes active browser sessions when a user is disabled or their access changes
Records authenticated administrator, effective user, session, and impersonation state on support-mode activity
Rotates browser credentials when entering or leaving support mode
Blocks user-access, workspace, integration, agent-authorization, and backup mutations while viewing as another user
Authenticates the agent dispatch worker with dedicated signed headers instead of fabricating a human browser cookie
Redirects expired browser tabs to sign-in without treating transient network failures as logout events
Includes CRM-projected cards in dashboard project-board status counts without treating reference cards as agent tasks
Scopes dashboard task and pipeline reads to explicit selected workspace IDs
Refreshes dashboard selections in place instead of reloading the full application
